transition.rule: Nothing from the instrument is deleted. Each obligation is either CARRIED_FORWARD because the new front door still owes it, or SUPERSEDED because the mechanism it governed no longer exists. Every receipt of v0 is preserved verbatim in this corpus, and the history guards walk both lineages.

transition.SUPERSEDED: SUPERSEDED — governing mechanism retired. This obligation applied to instrument-v1 and remains preserved with its admitted evidence. It does not bind the successor drawing-set interface because the mechanism it constrained is no longer present. Supersession is not satisfaction, failure, or revocation of historical evidence.
transition.effective_verdict_of_a_superseded_obliga: SUPERSEDED — neither PASS, FAIL nor NOT_EVALUATED; it enters no projection or release judgment and gains no receipt on a build that does not ship its mechanism; its recorded observations stand.
